resources.string: Per-app keyboard remapper for the OnePlus Pad 3 official keyboard. Frees the Meta/Super key from Oplus\'s draw-mode gesture, turns Esc into a real Escape, and maps the top row to F1-F12 behind an Fn key (the Search key).
Deliver the bot/AI key as a real Meta/Super to the ticked apps
The Search key is the Fn modifier; it stays blocked everywhere
Hold Search + a top-row key to get its original action (brightness, media, volume)
Diagnostic only; leave off for normal use
Not granted WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS — changes cannot be saved.\nRun once: pm grant com.minis.kbremap android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
